points.description: Osmosis occurs across a partially permeable membrane from high to low water concentration / down a water potential gradient
Diffusion is net movement of particles
Diffusion occurs from high to low concentration / down a concentration gradient
substrate binds to the enzyme's active site
active site is not rigid, it changes shape / moulds around the substrate
this strains bonds or holds substrates together so reaction is more likely
products released, enzyme unchanged and reusable
high temperature breaks the bonds holding the enzyme's shape
active site shape changes / enzyme denatures
plant cells have a cell wall, animal cells do not
plant cells have chloroplasts, animal cells do not
plant cells have a large permanent vacuole, animal cells have small vacuoles or none
No nucleus leaves more room for haemoglobin
so each cell can carry more oxygen
small flexible / biconcave shape helps squeeze through capillaries
